title: Systems & Linux Administrator ( Cloud Infrastructure)
description:
**Location:** Abu Dhabi, UAE

* **Cloud & Hypervisors:** Working knowledge of AWS or Microsoft Azure, along with familiarity with VMware, Proxmox, or KVM.

The ideal candidate should have previous experience working with a **study\-abroad/overseas education consultancy** and understand student counselling, university selection, admissions and the application process.

Key Responsibilities

* Counsel students and parents regarding **study\-abroad opportunities** across destinations such as the UK, Europe, USA and other international destinations.
* Understand students' academic backgrounds, career goals, financial requirements and preferences.
* Recommend suitable **countries, universities, courses and study pathways** based on individual student profiles.
* Handle **walk\-in, phone and digital enquiries/leads** effectively.
* Build trust with students and parents and address their questions and objections professionally.
* Follow up consistently with prospective students and maintain an organised counselling pipeline.
* Guide students through university selection and the application and admission process.
* Explain admission requirements, tuition fees, scholarships, intakes and available study pathways.
* Assist students throughout the admission process and ensure timely follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with **application, documentation and visa teams** to ensure a smooth student journey.
* Maintain accurate student records and update the counselling pipeline.
* Work towards monthly counselling, conversion and admission targets.
* Build strong and lasting relationships with students and parents.

Requirements

* **1–3 years of experience in study\-abroad counselling or overseas education consulting.**
* **Previous experience working in a study\-abroad agency/consultancy is required.**
* Good knowledge of international education destinations, universities and admission processes.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent student counselling and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong follow\-up, negotiation and lead\-conversion abilities.
* Ability to work towards targets and deadlines.
* Good command of English.
* Knowledge of **Malayalam and/or Tamil** will be an advantage.
* Confident, self\-motivated and performance\-oriented approach.

What We Offer

* **₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month**, based on experience and suitability.
* **Performance\-based incentives.**
* Career growth opportunities within the study\-abroad industry.
* Opportunity to work with international education programs and universities.
* Supportive and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to build expertise across international destinations, universities and study pathways.

We are looking for people who want to **grow with the organisation**, not just fill a position.

High\-performing counsellors can take on greater responsibilities and progress towards **Senior Counsellor / Team Lead** roles as they develop their skills and consistently deliver results.
